name: comp-384
blurb: A popover styled like a tooltip, with interactive content and a call-to-action button.
description: Popover (not a pure tooltip) containing title, description text, and an interactive button. Used for richer content that requires interaction.
use_when: Tooltips that need an action button or interactive element within.
avoid_when: Simple text hints; popovers are heavier than tooltips.
a11y: Button has aria-label; popover is not keyboard-accessible.
